## Problem

almost every lane on 2026-11-15 (t-y6vrqh7, t-f5bfhd0, t-a3dsm8g, t-1dtcrj8, t-vpvn2pv, t-65nnfyp, t-9e...) hit the Stop hook complaining about a missing commit after krn pr ship had merged and deleted the branch and worktree; lanes then spent turns explaining (final replies start 'the branch was deleted after merge, so the hook sees no commit').

## Change

Outcome: the Stop hook (src/hook/stop.ts and the lane/worktree resolution it uses) treats a lane whose branch was shipped and merged (ship verdict 'verdict: merged <sha>' for that branch, or the branch's PR merged on origin) as done and allows Stop without a commit on the deleted branch.

- fix(hook): Stop accepts a lane whose ship merged and removed its branch (t-t76x6w0)

## Verification

npm run fast PASS; node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts 60 pass

## Assumptions

- record path .krn/runs/ship/<encoded branch>.json in the main checkout; match by branch (worktree dir name) or KRN_TASK; consulted only when the lane branch is gone (hook branch empty or base); record must be an ancestor of the base; module in src/repo/ship-record.ts because boundaries forbid hook->deliver

## Problem

on 2026-11-14 five lanes (#844 #845 #846 #847 #848) merged through bin/krn pr ship, which removes the lane worktree and branch; the SubagentStop hook added by t-07p7k0y (#839) then evaluated the main checkout on main, found no new commit and refused the end, so each lane had to print 'BLOCKER:' although it succeeded. That mislabels every successful lane as blocked and costs a turn.

## Change

Outcome: the Stop hook accepts a krn-lane subagent end when its cwd is the main checkout on the base branch and the lane's ship merged (e.g. the last assistant message carries 'verdict: merged <sha>' and that sha is on origin/main, or a ship receipt under .krn/ names it); a lane without a merged ship is still refused.

- fix(hook): a lane whose ship merged may end at the main checkout (t-12yk5za)

## Verification

npm run fast: PASS
